source: generated from storyboard/cat-design.storyboard.json (rev round-3) by cues-from-storyboard.mjs; lines and anchors are the storyboard's own shots[].vo, shifted onto the delivered timeline (poster card 2.000 s in front, end card 2.000 s at the back)

sections.name: preroll
sections.note: the 2.000 s poster card: the pad and the logo mnemonic only. No kick, no bass, no hats, no plucks; the first hit is on the cut out of the card

sections.name: lift
sections.note: plucks up an octave, FM index down, shimmer in

sections.name: out
sections.note: single hit, then ring out under the end card, which now holds the spoken close

swells.note: reverse swell into the lift and the end card

bed.padNote: the sustained band-limited chord, voiced two and three octaves above the plucks so it lives in 1-4 kHz - the band a voice rest sounds empty in - without touching the 20-200 Hz anti-engine band.

lines.text: Design is the biggest group: values, locators, and the page read back as a map.
Design the values points at a field and reads what it declares.
Its type, its minimum, its maximum, its options, whether it is required.
lines.why: all five draws of "Its type, its minimum, its maximum, its options, whether it is required." ended +4.4 to +14.6 ST. A four-item list, which is the shape this fault keeps choosing.

lines.text: Out come the distinct classes of input, and the exact value on every edge.
Four chosen values cover more than forty random ones, and each is named.
Try nasty values offers the awkward values built for that exact field.
Very long text, Arabic, a date in 1800, an emoji, or nothing at all.
The field you picked stays picked, so the next value goes where the last did.
Most bugs live at the edges, and this hands you the edges.
Fill the form fills every field at once, the way a tester would.
A real phone number, an IBAN that passes its checksum, a date in range.
In Arabic where the page is Arabic, and it does not press submit.
Filled, rejected, or left alone: every field is named on the card.
Harvest the page reads every button, link and field on it.
Each one gets a locator that has been checked against the page itself.
A page map, a Playwright page object, and a brief an AI can use.
That is an afternoon of guessing selectors, done, with every guess marked.
Copy a locator hands you the one line of code a test needs.
Click the thing instead of writing the selector by hand.
Shift-click several, press Enter, and all of them are copied, one per line.
Each one is checked to match one thing, and only one, before it is handed over.
Draw the flow turns what you just did into a diagram on one page.
Start, each step, a decision where the application answered, the end.
A red box where it failed, and the user story beside it in Arabic.
A product owner asks for this picture, and a tester never has time to draw it.
Reverse-engineer the spec reads this page back as a draft specification.
Every form and what it accepts, every button, and where the links go.
lines.why: TWO full sets of five draws of "Every form and what it accepts, every button, and where the links go." failed the contour gate (set 1 +1.4 to +10.6 ST, set 2 +4.5 to +11.4 ST). A three-item list ending on "where the links go", which is the shape this fault keeps choosing. A third set is being bought rather than leaving the film unvoiced; if it fails too, this line is the director's to rewrite.

lines.text: Written up as requirements with acceptance criteria, in Arabic and English.
Most software this old has no spec, and this leaves you editing a draft.
Send a request calls the site's own API as the user who is logged in.
Method, URL, headers, body, and environments with variables in them.
Import an endpoint this session already watched, and re-send it with one header changed.
No token is copied anywhere, and the answer goes into the timeline.
Eight tools, and every one hands back something a suite can use.
QA Wrap. Every failure, traced.
lines.delivery: warm, unhurried, final. Not a sell

voice.note: The commercial's final recipe: one Gemini request per line, one voice and one delivery instruction, the gate selecting by shot fit among contour-passing draws, the clean chain with a +6 dB bell at 3.9 kHz whose gain is inside the voice trim.
